assumptions: autonomous session: no human present, no question asked; every missing value resolved to the most conservative default and recorded here
predict applies the avalanche branch BEFORE the tail formula, so an avalanche residue always bills P1 + L (never under-predict a bill)

vLLM's avalanche at residue 0/1 is UNMEASURED (27 residues swept, none 0/1): the rule is kept so a host is never given a number that is too low, but every such turn is flagged avalanche_extrapolated=True and counted by summarise(); the alternative -- refusing to predict -- leaves the host with no number

FRAMING_TOKENS=12 is the measured request shape's constant; a host with a different template must pass L directly, and record() refuses L and payload_tokens together so the two cannot disagree silently

LEDGER_CODES was NOT extended: tests/test_negative_controls.py asserts len(set(LEDGER_CODES))==5 and a 12-code total, so the four law codes live in LEDGER_LAW_CODES and both totals (5+4, 16 named codes) are asserted in test_ledger.py instead of regressing a passing guard
